messages:
mai: Canary A deployed (tag=canary-2026-03-21-c). Starting post-deploy verification across canary hosts.

deploy-bot: sequencer started id=sw-3301 step=post-deploy-smoke cohorts=4

chen: quick snapshot: p50=24ms p95=215ms, small 5xx blip at 22:18 UTC, embed.rerank showing a tail on eu2-quant3

oncall-rita: looking at logs: tokenizer init pauses and short malloc stalls on eu2-quant3-12 after scale-up

product-sam: propose token-warm + kv-prefill on affected hosts before expanding. If regression persists -> pin/rollback.

mai: submitting focused synth for short-prompts-C against embed.rerank concurrency=3

infra-bot: synth job queued -> running id=sw-3301-s1 target=eu2-shadow

chen: synth results: 120 reqs, success 116, p95=275ms, avg=82ms, 5xx=4 clustered to eu2-quant3-12

oncall-rita: infra timeline shows scale-down at 22:13 then scale-up at 22:16; host rejoined cold

mai: executing token-warm + kv-prefill on eu2-quant3-12 and eu2-quant3-14 now. snippet: ```for h in eu2-quant3-12 eu2-quant3-14; do curl -s 'http://$h/internal/token-warm'; curl -s 'http://$h/internal/kv-prefill?set=short-c'; done```

infra-bot: token-warm/prefill job complete -> success

product-sam: re-running targeted synth vs those hosts only

mai: targeted synth finished: 50 reqs, success 50, p95=105ms, avg=34ms, 0 failures

chen: global p95 now ~188ms. prefills flattened host tail.

mai: decision: keep hold for 10m to observe. Expand if stable. Pin to v2026-03-20-22 and rollback playbook if p95 >260ms for >10m or synth errors >0.5% with host correlation.

alex: adding note to release draft: 'Transient p95 regression caused by autoscaler-induced cache/tokenization churn in eu2; mitigated by token-warm + kv-prefill. No user impact observed.'

deploy-bot: holding expansion until approval or timeout 23:00 UTC

oncall-rita: watching dashboards; will post final status before expansion

mai: thanks — leaving change window open until 23:00 UTC. If all green, proceed to cohort B at T+12m.
